detailed_descriptions.en: Ex-Zodiac is a fast-paced rail shooter with a stylized look reminiscent of early 90's 3D games. Join protagonist Kyuu as she fights to free the worlds of the Sanzaru Star System, overrun by the intergalactic terrorist organization known as Zodiac . FEATURING: - A retro, colourful, low-poly visual style - 11 main levels and 6 bonus levels currently (more than 12 will be available after full release) - Major bosses at the end of each level, each piloted by a member of the Zodiac - A 16-bit style soundtrack by +TEK combining FM and wavetable synthesis - Barrel rolls CONTROLS: This game plays best using an Xinput compatible analogue controller (Xbox, PS4 etc), however digital devices can be used too, such as a D-pad or keyboard (analogue is definitely the way to go, though!). The controls are also re-mappable. CREDITS: Code, Design, Art, Sound Effects: Ben Hickling (MNKY) Music: +TEK Published by Pixeljam
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: Ex-Zodiac 是一款快節奏的軌道射擊遊戲，其美術風格讓人想起 90 年代初的 3D 遊戲。扮演主角 Kyuu，她為解放被星際恐怖組織「黃道帶」佔領的 Sanzaru 星系而戰鬥。 特色： - 復古、多彩、低多邊形的視覺風格 - 目前有 8 個主要關卡和 6 個附加關卡（完整版將有 12 個以上的可玩關卡） - 多條完成遊戲的路線 - 每個關卡結束時的主要頭目，都是由黃道帶的成員來駕駛 - 由「+TEK」製作，結合調頻和波表合成器的 16-bit 風格原聲帶”
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hans: Ex-Zodiac是一款快节奏的90年代怀旧画风3D轨道射击游戏。与主角Kyuu一起，为解放被银河系恐怖组织黄道带蹂躏的Sanzaru星系而战斗。 特性： -复古、彩色、低多边形的视觉风格 -目前拥有8个主要关卡和6个奖励关卡（正式版本发布后将超过12个关卡） -可选多条路线完成游戏 -每个关卡的最后都有一个大boss，每个boss都由黄道带的一名成员驾驶 -由+TEK制作，融合FM和wavetable synthesis的16位风格原声带
detailed_descriptions.ja: 90年代初期の名作群に大きくインスパイアされた、高速ローポリ3D奥スクロールシューティング。サンザル星系の星々が、超銀河テロ組織『ゾディアック』に侵略されている。主人公キュウ、彼女と解放の戦いに出撃しよう。 特徴： - レトロでカラフル。ローポリで描かれた映像世界 - 8つのメインステージと6つのボーナスステージを実装済み（フルリリース時には12ステージ以上） - マルチルートでのゲームクリアが可能 - 各ステージの最後には、『ゾディアック』の面々が駆る大ボス - FM音源とウェーブテーブル・シンセの融合。+TEK氏の16bit調サウンドトラック

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Ex-Zodiac is a fast-paced rail shooter with a stylized look reminiscent of early 90's 3D games. Join protagonist Kyuu as she fights to free the worlds of the Sanzaru Star System, overrun by the intergalactic terrorist organization known as Zodiac.

FEATURING:

- A retro, colourful, low-poly visual style

- 11 main levels and 6 bonus levels currently (more than 12 will be available after full release)

- Major bosses at the end of each level, each piloted by a member of the Zodiac

- A 16-bit style soundtrack by +TEK combining FM and wavetable synthesis

- Barrel rolls

CONTROLS:

This game plays best using an Xinput compatible analogue controller (Xbox, PS4 etc), however digital devices can be used too, such as a D-pad or keyboard (analogue is definitely the way to go, though!). The controls are also re-mappable.

CREDITS:

Code, Design, Art, Sound Effects: Ben Hickling (MNKY)

Music: +TEK

Published by Pixeljam

特色：

- 多條完成遊戲的路線
- 每個關卡結束時的主要頭目，都是由黃道帶的成員來駕駛
- 由「+TEK」製作，結合調頻和波表合成器的 16-bit 風格原聲帶”
